decisions.decision: Use a regenerated clean bright workshop photograph with separate DOM typography modeled on the supplied SKL reference.
decisions.reason: The user requested the bright reference composition together with animated hero text, which requires accessible live typography.

decisions.decision: Use 21st Glass Card compound structure and 21st Scroll Reveal motion pattern adapted to native project CSS and motion/react.
decisions.reason: Preserves Vite architecture while grounding glass and motion in retrieved 21st components.

decisions.decision: Use Onest for interface copy, Unbounded for display headings, and a two-row infinite portfolio marquee with hover-revealed captions.
decisions.reason: Matches the user-selected LANDOS reference while preserving the existing SKL hero composition and orange industrial identity.

decisions.decision: Remove all calculator surfaces and route every primary application CTA directly to the expanded lead form with optional promo code.
decisions.reason: The user explicitly removed cost calculation from the site and selected a larger, wider application-first CTA treatment.
